T. orientalis qPCR was conducted according to a previously described multiplex hydrolysis probe qPCR assay (Bogema et al., 2015). A generic PCR assay targeting the 18S rRNA gene of the Piroplasmida was also conducted using previously described primers Piroplasmid-F: 5′- CCAG CAGCCGCGGTAATT-3′ and Piroplasmid-R: 5′-CTTTCGCAGTAGTTYG- TCTTTAACAAATCT-3’ (Tabar et al., 2008; Baneth et al., 2013). Amplification was carried out with the BIOTAQ™ DNA Polymerase kit (Bioline) to make up a 25 μL PCR cocktail containing: 1 X BIOTAQ buffer, 1.5 mM MgCl 2, 0.2 mM dNTPs, 0.4 μM of each primer, 1 unit of BIOTAQ DNA polymerase and molecular grade water. PCR was carried out with the following thermal cycling parameters: Initial denaturation 94 ̊C for 3 min followed by 35 cycles at 94 ̊C for 30 s, 64 ̊C for 45 s, 72 ̊C for 30 s with a final extension of 72 ̊C for 7 min. Full length Theileria bicornis 18S rRNA gene was amplified with primers 18 SAN, 18SBN (Nijhof et al.,

and another pair of internal primers designed for this study, 18S-F1: 5′-GATCCTGCCAGTAGTCATATG-3′ and 18S-R1: 5′-TACTCCCCCCAGAACCCA-3’. PCR products were viewed on a 1.5% agarose 0.5 × TBE gel stained with GelRed (Biotium, USA), purified with QIAquick PCR purification kit (Qiagen) and subjected to Sanger sequencing with the primers described above. 2.

Molecular phylogeny Phylogenetic analysis of 1474 bp of the 18S rRNA gene of the C. simum and D. bicornis piroplasmid strains demonstrates the close relationship to T. bicornis (Fig. 2). steps.title: Extract DNA with DNeasy kit
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extractions from blood or tissue using the DNeasy Blood & Tissue DNA Extraction Kit (Qiagen) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Run T. orientalis multiplex qPCR
steps.instruction: Conduct Theileria orientalis quantitative PCR using the previously described multiplex hydrolysis‑probe qPCR assay (Bogema et al., 2015).

steps.title: Set up generic 18S rRNA PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL PCR reaction with BIOTAQ™ DNA Polymerase kit (Bioline) containing 1 X BIOTAQ buffer, 1.5 mM MgCl₂, 0.2 mM dNTPs, 0.4 µM each primer (Piroplasmid‑F: 5′‑CCAG CAGCCGCGGTAATT‑3′; Piroplasmid‑R: 5′‑CTTTCGCAGTAGTTYG‑TCTTTAACAAATCT‑3′), 1 U BIOTAQ DNA polymerase and molecular‑grade water; add extracted DNA template; run thermal cycling: 94 °C 3 min initial denaturation, then 35 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 64 °C 45 s, 72 °C 30 s, followed by a final extension at 72 °C for 7 min.

substeps.instruction: Combine the listed reagents to a total volume of 25 µL.
Add the DNA template to the master mix.
Place the tube in a thermal cycler and run the specified program.

steps.title: Amplify full‑length 18S rRNA gene
steps.instruction: Perform PCR to amplify the full‑length Theileria bicornis 18S rRNA gene using primers 18 SAN and 18 SBN (Nijhof et al., 2003) together with the internal primers 18S‑F1: 5′‑GATCCTGCCAGTAGTCATATG‑3′ and 18S‑R1: 5′‑TACTCCCCCCAGAACCCA‑3′ (PCR conditions as above unless otherwise specified).

steps.title: Visualise PCR products on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Run the PCR amplicons on a 1.5 % agarose gel prepared with 0.5 × TBE buffer and stained with GelRed (Biotium, USA).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1.5 % agarose solution in 0.5 × TBE.
Add GelRed stain to the molten agarose before casting.
Load PCR products alongside a suitable DNA ladder.
Run electrophoresis at an appropriate voltage until separation is achieved.

steps.title: Purify PCR amplicons
steps.instruction: Clean the gel‑extracted PCR products using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit (Qiagen) according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Sanger sequence purified amplicons
steps.instruction: Submit the purified PCR products for Sanger sequencing using the same primers described for each amplification (Piroplasmid‑F/R, 18 SAN/18 SBN, 18S‑F1/18S‑R1).

steps.title: Perform molecular phylogenetic analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the obtained 18S rRNA sequences by aligning them in Geneious version 7.1.9, performing a nucleotide BLAST search against GenBank, then conducting phylogenetic analysis with DNAdist in the PHYLIP package and generating a neighbour‑joining tree with 1000 bootstrap replicates, including 19 Theileria spp., six Babesia spp., one Cytauxzoon sp., and Toxoplasma gondii as the outgroup.

substeps.instruction: Import sequences into Geneious 7.1.9 and align them.
Run a nucleotide BLAST comparison against the GenBank database.
Use DNAdist (PHYLIP) to calculate distance matrices.
Construct a neighbour‑joining tree and perform 1000 bootstrap replicates.
Annotate the tree with the specified taxa (19 Theileria spp., six Babesia spp., one Cytauxzoon sp., T. gondii as outgroup).
